SELECT id, x FROM (VALUES (1, 'a', 'u', 3.0::DOUBLE, 2.0::DOUBLE), (2, 'a', NULL, 4.0::DOUBLE, 1.0::DOUBLE),
    (3, NULL, 'v', 5.0::DOUBLE, 3.0::DOUBLE), (4, 'b', 'v', 6.0::DOUBLE, 4.0::DOUBLE)) t(id, g, k, c, w) DECIDE x(REAL), per (): y(REAL), per t.k: z(REAL)
        SUCH THAT x <= 9 AND y <= 9 AND z <= 9 AND x <= sum(from previous to next: t.c) over (t.id) MAXIMIZE sum(x) + y + sum(z)
